The stock of Moody's Corporation (MCO) formed an up wedge with $186.32 target or 8.00 % above today’s $172.52 share price. The 5 months wedge indicates low risk for the $33.11B company. If the $186.32 price target is reached, the company will be worth $2.65 billion more. Rising wedges, especially for downward breakouts are tricky moments to trade. Investors must be aware that the break even failure rate for up or down breakouts is: 8% and 24%. The average rise is 28% and the decline is 14%. Wedges has high throwback and pullback rate: 73%, 63% and the percent of wedges meeting target is not more than 50%.
